title: Contact
headline: Get in touch

seo.title: Contact Collettivo Alan Turing | LGBTQ+ community at PoliTO
seo.description: Get in touch with Collettivo Alan Turing, an LGBTQ+ organisation and queer student community at Politecnico di Torino (PoliTO) in Turin.

intro:
Have a question, need a hand or want to share an idea? Get in touch.

If you’re an organisation that would like to support us or work with us, we’d like to hear from you too.
